answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Solana account rent history. It requires rent paid on Solana for two years, so the walnut of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Honest agents already carry what Solana account rent history asks for, so they pass without noticing; the hollow is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. A farm doing the maths finds the plume first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
